heading: Paid sales activation checklist
activeNote: Paid sales are activated for this event. Checkout and payout records remain simulated; no real money is charged.

intro: Sandbox verification, payout connection, and activation fees apply to this event. No real identity documents, bank details, or payments are required. A platform administrator approves each paid event before it can be published.

review.changesRequired: Event details changed after submission. Submit the updated event for review.
review.rejected: The administrator rejected this paid event. Address the reason and submit again.
